title: Ordonnance n° 2023-1142 du 6 décembre 2023 relative à la publication et à la certification d'informations en matière de durabilité et aux obligations environnementales, sociales et de gouvernement d'entreprise des sociétés commerciales
citation: Ordonnance n° 2023-1142 du 6 décembre 2023, JORF n° 0283 du 7 décembre 2023, NOR JUSC2327648R (transposes Directive (EU) 2022/2464)
evidence: Art. 32: "Sous réserve des dispositions particulières prévues aux articles 33 à 42, les dispositions de la présente ordonnance entrent en vigueur le 1er janvier 2024." Art. 36 III: "Le XIX de l'article 31 entre en vigueur le lendemain de la publication de la présente ordonnance." Published JORF n°0283 of 7 December 2023 (JORF file metadata, ORIGINE_PUBLI); the LEGI consolidated text starts 2023-12-08 (LIEN_TXT debut="2023-12-08", etat VIGUEUR). Read in the DILA JORF and LEGI files on 2026-11-02; legifrance.gouv.fr itself answered 403.
notes: in_force is 2023-12-08, the day after publication, when Art. 36 III and the Légifrance consolidated text begin; the general date in Art. 32 is 2024-01-01 and Art. 33 I sets 2025-01-01 for the Code de commerce sustainability articles (the register row said the initial date was not established; these are the sentences). Records (fr): adopted 2023-12-08 (visas, articles as published, signatures; the JO notice is not stored) and consolidated 2023-12-08 and 2025-05-03 (in the consolidation the amending articles are one summary line each, "A modifié les dispositions suivantes", and Art. 33, 34, 37 and 38 changed on 2025-05-03). Art. 4 renumbered Code de commerce L. 225-102-4 and L. 225-102-5 as L. 225-102-1 and L. 225-102-2 (see fr-devoir-de-vigilance). Implemented by fr-decret-2023-1394. English: the Légifrance translations page (https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/liste/traductions) answered 403 to curl and headless Chromium, so no English was found or stored (row FR-LEGIFRANCE-TRANSLATION is permission requested).

title: Code de commerce, art. L. 232-6-3 and L. 232-6-4: sustainability information in the management report (companies and third-country branches)
citation: Code de commerce art. L. 232-6-3 and L. 232-6-4, created by Ordonnance n° 2023-1142 du 6 décembre 2023; L. 232-6-3 amended by Loi n° 2025-391 du 30 avril 2025 art. 8

Version metadata: DATE_DEBUT 2025-01-01, ETAT MODIFIE then VIGUEUR. Read in the DILA LEGI files on 2026-11-02.
notes: Brief named L. 232-6-3 et seq.; the set is L. 232-6-3 (sustainability information) and L. 232-6-4 (third-country companies with a branch in France). L. 232-6-2, in between, is the payments-to-governments report and is not included. Versions (Légifrance article ids): L. 232-6-3 LEGIARTI000048521225 (2025-01-01), LEGIARTI000051559591 (2025-05-03, Loi 2025-391 art. 8); L. 232-6-4 LEGIARTI000048521231 (2025-01-01, unchanged). Two records (fr): 2025-01-01 and 2025-05-03. The Ordinance's application dates by financial year (Art. 33 to 42) are in fr-ordonnance-2023-1142. English not found: see that entry.

title: Code de commerce, art. L. 225-102-4 and L. 225-102-5 (since 2025-01-01 L. 225-102-1 and L. 225-102-2): duty of vigilance of parent and ordering companies
citation: Code de commerce art. L. 225-102-4 and L. 225-102-5, inserted by Loi n° 2017-399 du 27 mars 2017 (JORF 28 mars 2017); renumbered L. 225-102-1 and L. 225-102-2 by Ordonnance n° 2023-1142 art. 4
evidence: Version metadata of LEGIARTI000034291360 (L. 225-102-4) and LEGIARTI000034291364 (L. 225-102-5): DATE_DEBUT 2017-03-29, the day after publication of Loi n° 2017-399 on 28 March 2017. Read in the DILA LEGI files on 2026-11-02.
notes: Deviation from the brief: since 2025-01-01 the two articles are numbered L. 225-102-1 and L. 225-102-2 (Ordonnance n° 2023-1142 art. 4 5° and 6°: "Il devient l'article L. 225-102-1", "Il devient l'article L. 225-102-2"); Légifrance shows L. 225-102-4 and L. 225-102-5 as transferred, and the old L. 225-102-1 (non-financial performance statement) is repealed. The records follow the duty across the renumbering. Versions: L. 225-102-4 LEGIARTI000034291360 (2017-03-29), LEGIARTI000035181820 (2017-07-14, Ordonnance 2017-1162 art. 11), LEGIARTI000043978824 (2024-01-01, Loi 2021-1104 art. 273); L. 225-102-5 LEGIARTI000034291364; from 2025-01-01 LEGIARTI000048535098 and LEGIARTI000048535129. The 2017 text carries the Conseil constitutionnel's note that the civil fine was declared contrary to the Constitution (in the stored text as published by Légifrance). Four records (fr): 2017-03-29, 2017-07-14, 2024-01-01, 2025-01-01. English not found: see fr-ordonnance-2023-1142.

title: Code de l'énergie, art. L. 100-4: national climate and energy targets
citation: Code de l'énergie art. L. 100-4, as rewritten by Loi n° 2015-992 (2015-08-19 version), Loi n° 2019-1147 du 8 novembre 2019 art. 1 (2019-11-10 version) and Loi n° 2023-491 du 22 juin 2023 art. 1 (2023-06-24 version)
evidence: Version metadata of LEGIARTI000023985182: DATE_DEBUT 2011-06-01 (first version); link of LEGIARTI000039369320 (2019-11-10): "LOI n°2019-1147 du 8 novembre 2019 - art. 1". Read in the DILA LEGI files on 2026-11-02.
notes: Deviation from the brief, which placed L. 100-4 in the Code de l'environnement: it is in the Code de l'énergie. The 2011-06-01 version is only a cross-reference to the 2005 and 2009 programme laws; the climate targets (-40 % in 2030, factor four in 2050) start with the version of 2015-08-19 and carbon neutrality in 2050 with that of 2019-11-10. Six records (fr): 2011-06-01, 2015-08-19, 2019-11-10, 2021-08-25, 2023-03-12, 2023-06-24. English not found: see fr-ordonnance-2023-1142.

title: AMF position-recommandation DOC-2020-03: information to be provided by collective investment schemes that use non-financial approaches
citation: AMF doctrine DOC-2020-03 (position-recommandation); applicable version of 30 December 2024
evidence: Archive list on the AMF page opened 2026-11-02 (HTTP 200, text/html, 200854 bytes): "Du 11 mars 2020 au 26 juillet 2020 | Position - Recommandation DOC-2020-03 Informations à fournir par les placements collectifs intégrant des approches extra-financières"; the current version is shown as "Applicable au 30 décembre 2024".
notes: Regulator doctrine, not an enacted act: a position-recommandation that applies to French collective investment schemes and to foreign UCITS marketed in France, citing Code monétaire et financier L. 533-12, L. 533-22-1 and L. 533-22-2-1 (see fr-cmf-l533-22-1). Link only: the AMF terms (https://www.amf-france.org/fr/mentions-legales-et-editoriales) say "Toute utilisation à des fins commerciales ou publicitaires est exclue", so the row FR-AMF-DOCTRINE is permission requested and nothing is stored. The AMF doctrine page lists six dated versions (from 2020-03-11); the page was not parsed for text. English was not looked for: nothing is stored under a row that is not pass.
